methods: fH.lI (A.a DOM casts and A.l1 widget construction stubbed)
conclusions: Every existing nonempty inventory slot is replaced, including used-miracle slots. Empty gift placeholders remain the same widgets.
Replacement physical IDs/model/fake/used values come from the supplied wire records; lI does not sample gifts, assign new IDs or force unused flags.
The replaceItems receiver clears the public used-model pane for its player; only that player's own physical hand uses lI. This report exercises the two helpers separately, not server event fanout.
limitations: Rendering replacement is not proof of server order relative to178 consumption, Dream application, incoming body, revival or gifts.
The v29 all-live-copies/new-token/unused/Dream-masked redraw transition is an explicit experimental contract beyond this receiver evidence.
A short supplied replacement list throws in the client helper; excess rows remain unused. The renderer does not establish an authoritative replacement-count validation rule.
DOM/widget visuals are stubbed, and no network, account, application startup or game connection runs.
